text:
ruth_cust: Hey team — our /rerank calls started failing after last night's deploy. Getting a 413 with body 'Payload too large'. We didn't increase the number of docs, just a minor client change. Anyone seen this?

mike_support: sorry you're hitting this — can you paste the exact curl and a minimal request body you used? Which model/endpoint version?

ruth_cust: posting sanitized repro below. Endpoint: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank

```bash
curl -X POST \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
    "query": "Find the best matching passage for symptoms of latency in model serving...",
    "documents": [
      {"id": "d1", "text": "<very long doc content repeated ~12k chars>"},
      {"id": "d2", "text": "<...>"},
      {"id": "d3", "text": "<...>"}
    ]
  }' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank
```

ruth_cust: Response: HTTP/1.1 413 Payload Too Large
{ "error": "Payload too large" }

mike_support: thanks. Two quick angles: 1) server-side token counting can differ from naive char count; 2) we have a protection that soft-blocks requests that would cause high per-request token billing. Can you run a token estimate on your query+docs?

ruth_cust: we estimated chars only — rough numbers: query ~400 chars, docs combined ~48k chars. We thought tokens would still be under 8k.

sara_oncall: i'm checking the ingress logs for your org id. I see the request and our preflight token_estimate=52000 tokens for that body (we include whitespace and unicode factoring). That exceeds the rerank token ceiling (default 32k tokens for this tenant). The 413 is correct — but agree the message is vague.

deploy-bot: [rate-protect] soft-block applied to tenant T-1234 for large single-request token usage. Contact support to request temporary override after mitigation.

mike_support: apologies for the poor error text — it currently surfaces as 'Payload too large'. We'll file a short-term change to make it 'Request token estimate exceeds allowed ceiling: X tokens (limit Y)'. Jen, can product weigh in?

jen_prod: +1. UX should explicitly state estimated tokens and which field blew past the limit (query vs documents). Also we should surface a suggested client-side mitigation link (chunking / top_k heuristics). I'll open a ticket.

mike_support: for now, immediate workarounds:
- Trim document text server-side before sending (send passages/snippets instead of full doc).
- Precompute token counts client-side (we can share a tiny python snippet).
- Send smaller batches: rerank supports incremental chunking — send N docs per request and aggregate top-k locally.

mike_support: example chunking pattern (pseudo):
```python
# pseudocode: chunk docs into batches of 30
for batch in chunks(all_docs, 30):
    resp = client.rerank(query, documents=batch)
    collect(resp.scores)
# merge top k across batches
```

mike_support: or use our embeddings pipeline (embed all docs once, embed query, do cosine search to prune candidates, then rerank the pruned set). Embedding calls are cheaper for large corpora.

ruth_cust: thanks. Two followups: 1) The billing spike we saw — did the big request consume billable tokens even though it failed? 2) How do we get the soft-block cleared?

sara_oncall: failed requests that hit preflight token check are not billed (we only bill for successful token consumption). The billing spike is likely from an earlier successful bulk request around 3429871200 — i'm attaching the org-level recent-usage note in the ticket. For the soft-block: we place it automatically to prevent runaway costs; we can remove it after you confirm implemented mitigation or agree to a temporary quota increase.

mike_support: if you want a temporary higher ceiling while you roll out chunking, we can coordinate with accounts. But we require a short plan (how you'll reduce max per-request tokens).

ruth_cust: ok we'll implement client-side chunking + top-k pruning and also run token estimator before sending. Can you share the token estimator snippet?

mike_support: sure — here's a lightweight JS estimator (approx):
```js
function approxTokens(text){
  // rough heuristic: average 4 chars per token
  return Math.ceil(text.length / 4);
}
// estimate for query + docs
const total = approxTokens(query) + documents.reduce((s,d)=>s+approxTokens(d.text),0);
```

jen_prod: we'll also add better error wording in the API and a KB article: 'Why rerank returns 413 — how to estimate tokens and chunk requests'.

ruth_cust: implementing now. One more request: can you include per-doc token counts in the preflight error response? that would make client-side trimming easier.

mike_support: noted and will escalate — short-term we can include a support-only debug dump in a ticket if you paste the failing request id.

ruth_cust: request id is req_3429876543-abcd. Thanks all, will report back after patching. :thumbsup:

mike_support: great — ping here when done and we'll lift the soft-block if everything looks good.

sara_oncall: leaving a follow-up item to check whether we should change default tenant ceiling or add an opt-in large-request tier.

jen_prod: filed PROD-1897 for better error text + KB.

ruth_cust: patch deployed, tested chunking, initial run succeeded (no 413). Marking this as resolved for now — will reopen if anything else crops up. Thanks for fast help! :rocket:
